problems.name: HumanEval_19_sort_numbers
problems.completion:
let mut num_vec: Vec<u32> = numbers
        .split_whitespace()
        .map(|word| match word {
            "zero" => 0,
            "one" => 1,
            "two" => 2,
            "three" => 3,
            "four" => 4,
            "five" => 5,
            "six" => 6,
            "seven" => 7,
            "eight" => 8,
            "nine" => 9,
            _ => panic!("Invalid number word"),
        })
        .collect();

    num_vec.sort();

    num_vec
        .iter()
        .map(|&num| match num {
            0 => "zero",
            1 => "one",
            2 => "two",
            3 => "three",
            4 => "four",
            5 => "five",
            6 => "six",
            7 => "seven",
            8 => "eight",
            9 => "nine",
            _ => panic!("Invalid number"),
        })
        .collect::<Vec<&str>>()
        .join(" ")
